newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance cracker resumes operation.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance cracker resumes operation.

text.p: Indian petrochemicals firm Reliance Industries Ltd said on Tuesday its cracker complex at Hazira on the western coast resumed operations last week after a routine planned shutdown.

"During the shutdown period the company had adequate ethylene and propylene inventories to meet the requirement of all the downstream plants for producing polyethylene, monoethylene glycol, polyvinyl chloride and polypropylene and the company maintained targeted rates of production," it said.
The cracker has a capacity to produce 750,000 tonnes a year of ethylene, 365,000 tonnes of propylene and over one million tonnes a year of aromatics and other byproducts, it said.
The company did not say for how long the plant was closed. Analysts said it was shut down for about two weeks.
